subject: BMD Graduate Program 2027, Western Australia (SEEK 95410781), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: BMD's Foundations graduate program rotates graduates through engineering, construction, commercial and HSEQ teams on infrastructure projects in Western Australia.
letter.subject: BMD Graduate Program 2027, Western Australia (SEEK 95410781)
paragraphs: I saw your Foundations Graduate Program 2027 advert for Western Australia on SEEK and would like to apply for a civil engineering place.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019) and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In the Advanced Diploma I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, tracking procurement and materials and preparing site and progress reports. That matches the planning, coordination, reporting and documentation work your graduates support.

My site work so far was in the Philippines rather than in Australia. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth, with a driver's licence, my own transport, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the program.

checklist: Marc to decide whether to apply: BMD's program page says graduates may apply up to 24 months after completing studies; his degree was 2019 and his Advanced Diploma February 2026, and the advert asks for a degree
Confirm with Marc that he is willing to discuss relocating to Perth WA and that his work rights (to December 2027) suit a program running into 2028
Check Gmail again for any BMD receipt, then open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95410781 and confirm it is still open (closes 20 Nov 2026)
Apply through BMD's own application page via the SEEK link out (no agency submissions) with the master resume and the saved cover letter PDF
Note the receipt date in /workspace/job-finds (tracker recording is paused)
notes: Direct employer graduate program advert on SEEK, link out to BMD careers. Held: eligibility window and work rights duration unresolved.
